rules.statement: A plaintiff who buys property during the pendency of a mortgage action and obtains a Fiscal's transfer before the added defendant does not have an absolute right to a declaration of title against the added defendant, as the added defendant may still obtain a superior title through a subsequent mortgage decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, the result of this action is, in my opinion, almost absurd. Judgment has been given for the plaintiff, and it is admitted that all the added defendant has to do, now that he has obtained his Fiscal's transfer, is to bring another action and obtain a reversal of those proceedings."
